description: Context passed to an index tooltip (ChartTooltipMode.Index) — both to the built-in card and to any custom TooltipIndexTemplate. It describes one CATEGORY, not one point, so it carries every visible series at that index.

members.name: Index
members.description: Zero-based data index the crosshair stands on. On a time axis it is the index into ChartData.TimePoints, not the position of the tick on screen.

members.name: Label
members.description: The category label — the matching entry of ChartData.Labels, or the culture-formatted timestamp on a time axis.

members.name: Series
members.description: One entry per visible series at that index, in dataset order. Series hidden through the interactive legend, NaN gaps and series shorter than the index are absent, so a template never renders an empty row.

members.name: Total
members.description: Sum of every visible series value at the index (0 when no series is present). It is computed, not stored, so a template can show the category total without summing Series itself.
